note: Agent identity for the read layer. Flare has no on-chain agent registry, so name and description come from here; everything scored comes from the chain. The wallet is read from `addressEnv` at load time and is per-agent on purpose — reputation is keyed by wallet, so three agents sharing one key would share one Passport track and a leaderboard could never separate them.
